categories.main_business_segments: Jiangsu Feymer Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the hydrophilic functional polymers sector, serving water-based industries such as pulp and paper, water treatment, mineral processing, oil and gas extraction, and textile dyeing. Its main product lines include functional monomers, water-soluble polymers, water treatment membranes and membrane applications, and energy supply services. The company also engages in the production and sale of steam, electricity, and hydrogen for industrial use within its industrial park.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies in functional monomer synthesis, water-soluble polymer manufacturing, and membrane production, including proprietary microbial fermentation catalysts, continuous tubular reactor processes, and membrane casting techniques. It has developed 22 core technologies covering monomer production, polymer synthesis, membrane materials, membrane applications, and hydrogen production. The firm emphasizes precise molecular design, polymerization control, and application-specific product customization, supported by a strong R&D system and over 290 patents.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are industrial users in pulp and paper manufacturing, municipal and industrial water treatment, mineral processing, oil and gas fields, and textile dyeing sectors. The company serves both domestic and international markets, with a growing export footprint in Southeast Asia, Russia, and other regions. It also targets emerging applications in new energy, desertification control, and ecological restoration.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with production bases in Zhangjiagang, Anqing (Anhui), Suzhou, and Nantong. It actively expands its overseas presence, focusing on Southeast Asia, the Middle East, and Russia. Its products and services reach dozens of countries globally, supported by localized technical service centers and logistics hubs.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jiangsu Feymer Technology operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain. It produces key raw materials (functional monomers) and intermediate products (water-soluble polymers), manufactures membrane products, and provides application technology services. It also supplies energy (steam, electricity, hydrogen) to upstream industrial enterprises within its industrial park.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes green technology innovation aligned with national carbon neutrality goals, focusing on developing high-performance, environmentally friendly hydrophilic polymers and membrane technologies. R&D efforts target product quality improvement, cost reduction, and expanding applications in industrial water processes and ecological protection. It invests in digital transformation, smart manufacturing, and integrated water treatment solutions, while fostering talent development and industry collaboration.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of functional monomers, water-soluble polymers, membrane products, and energy supply. The company also earns income from water treatment membrane application services, including operational and engineering services. Sales are conducted via direct sales to large customers and distributors for smaller clients, with customized product development for key accounts.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with multinational chemical firms such as Ashland, Solenis, and Kemira in water treatment chemicals and polymers. In the membrane sector, it faces competition from established global membrane manufacturers and domestic state-owned enterprises. Jiangsu Feymer positions itself as a technology-driven leader in hydrophilic functional polymers and membrane applications, with a comprehensive product portfolio and strong application expertise, holding leading market shares in several niche segments.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 1.57 billion, a 4.54% decline from the previous year, mainly due to intensified downstream competition and raw material price decreases. Net profit attributable to shareholders was negative RMB 4.65 million, impacted by lower margins and increased depreciation from new projects. Total assets grew 8.43% to RMB 2.7 billion, while net assets decreased 6.72% to RMB 1.41 billion. The company is expanding capacity with a major new production base in Anqing expected to start trial production in mid-2025.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Jiangsu Feymer emphasizes its green technology mission to protect water resources by providing high-purity, high-activity functional monomers and customized hydrophilic polymers tailored to complex industrial water applications. Its integrated product and application technology service model addresses diverse customer needs, enhancing process efficiency, reducing environmental impact, and supporting sustainable industrial development. The company’s proprietary technologies, extensive patent portfolio, and strong R&D capabilities differentiate it in the competitive landscape.
